levels.name: Raging Vortex
levels.description: Palm Vortex pulls in opponents and objects within a 5m radius.

levels.name: Uprising Whirlwind
levels.description: Increases Energy Recharge by 16%.

levels.name: Sweeping Gust
levels.description: Increases the Level of Gust Surge by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Cherishing Breezes
levels.description: Reduces DMG taken while casting Palm Vortex by 10%.

levels.name: Vortex Stellaris
levels.description: Increases the Level of Palm Vortex by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Intertwined Winds
levels.description: Targets who take DMG from Gust Surge have their Anemo RES decreased by 20%. If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.

levels.name: Invincible Stonewall
levels.description: Party members within the radius of Wake of Earth have their CRIT Rate increased by 10% and have increased resistance against interruption.

levels.name: Rockcore Meltdown
levels.description: When the meteorite created by Starfell Sword is destroyed, it will also explode, dealing additional AoE Geo DMG equal to the amount of damage dealt by Starfell Sword.

levels.name: Will of the Rock
levels.description: Increases the Level of Wake of Earth by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Reaction Force
levels.description: The shockwave triggered by Wake of Earth regenerates 5 Energy for every opponent hit. A maximum of 25 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.

levels.name: Meteorite Impact
levels.description: Increases the Level of Starfell Sword by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Everlasting Boulder
levels.description: The barrier created by Wake of Earth lasts 5s longer. The meteorite created by Starfell Sword lasts 10s longer.

levels.name: Spring Thunder of Fertility
levels.description: The number of Abundance Amulets that can be generated using Lightning Blade is increased to 3.

levels.name: Violet Vehemence
levels.description: When Falling Thunder created by Bellowing Thunder hits an opponent, it will decrease their Electro RES by 15% for 8s.

levels.name: Distant Crackling
levels.description: Increases the Level of Bellowing Thunder by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Fickle Cloudstrike
levels.description: When a character obtains Abundance Amulets generated by Lightning Blade, if this character's Energy is less than 35%, the Energy restored by the Abundance Amulets is increased by 100%.

levels.name: Clamor in the Wilds
levels.description: Increases the Level of Lightning Blade by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: World-Shaker
levels.description: Every 2 Falling Thunder attacks triggered by Bellowing Thunder will significantly increase the DMG dealt by the next Falling Thunder, dealing 200% of its original DMG, and will restore an additional 1 Energy to the current character.

levels.name: Symbiotic Creeper
levels.description: After Razorgrass Blade hits an opponent, it will regenerate 3.5 Energy for the Traveler.

levels.name: Green Resilience
levels.description: Lea Lotus Lamp's duration is increased by 3s.

levels.name: Whirling Weeds
levels.description: Increases the Level of Razorgrass Blade by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Treacle Grass
levels.description: After the Lea Lotus Lamp triggers a Lotuslight Transfiguration, it will obtain 5 stacks of the Overflowing Lotuslight effect from the Passive Talent "Verdant Overgrowth." You must have unlocked this Passive Talent first.

levels.name: Viridian Transience
levels.description: Increases the Level of Surgent Manifestation by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Withering Aggregation
levels.description: The Dendro DMG Bonus of the character under the effect of Overflowing Lotuslight as created by the Lea Lotus Lamp is increased by 12%. If the Lamp has experienced a Lotuslight Transfiguration previously, the character will also gain 12% DMG Bonus for the corresponding element.
